title: 第570章 木谷梨乃查案第569章 收购帝京石化
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：乡野孽乱第一卷：默认第570章木谷梨乃查案（..la）两日后，超香宫亲王突然暴毙，由于他身份特殊，引起了东瀛朝野上下的高度关注。
很多人认为超香宫亲王死的很蹊跷，再加上他的两个儿子超香宫太郎和超香宫次郎都神秘失踪了，有人就提出让帝京警视厅介入调查。
帝京警视厅有点资格的警官都被干掉了，木谷梨乃成为资格最老的警官，就顺理成章地当上了厅长。
木谷梨乃来到亲王府，仔细查看了一番，超香宫亲王身上没有任何的伤痕，也没有中毒的迹象，。
法医鉴定是心源性猝死，由于是夜间发病，根本来不及抢救。
木谷梨乃来到帝京电力集团，敏锐地发现不止是超香宫太郎失踪，整个集团的男职员都失踪了，四十岁以上的女职员也失踪了。
整个总部只剩下一些年轻貌美的女职员在办公，看起来非常的养眼。
木谷梨乃又来到帝京石化集团，发现这里的情况跟帝京电力集团差不多，都是一些年轻貌美的女职员在办公。
她心里有数了，知道肯定是叶开干的。
她给叶开打了个电话，亲热地说，“老公，你在哪里呀？”
叶开已经猜到木谷梨乃找他为了什么，肯定是朝香宫亲王案发了，
“老婆，你今天怎么想起给我打电话了？”
“我们好久没见了，我挺想你的。”
“真的想我吗，我怎么很多天都没见你给我打个电话？”
“人家不是当了厅长工作繁忙嘛。”
“是工作繁忙还是另有新欢？”
“真的忙，整个警视厅都是新人，累死我了。”
“你真的想我吗？”
“真的，想的都快要不行了。”
“怎么不行了？”

木谷梨乃娇嗔道，“讨厌，你又不是不知道，赶紧说，你在哪里？”
“我在电力集团。”
“哪个电力集团？”
“还有哪个，就是帝京电力集团呗。”
“啊，这么巧，你在哪个办公室？”
“我在董事长办公室。”
话音未落，木谷梨乃已经推开董事长办公室的门进来。
她关上门，来到叶开面前坐下，严肃地说，“叶先生，你有麻烦了。”
“我有什么麻烦？”
“你干了什么自己不知道吗？”
“我干什么了？”
“你害死了超香宫亲王，还有他的儿子超香宫太郎和超香宫次郎，你兼并了他们的公司，杀死了男职员，只留下年轻貌美的女职员，你犯下了大罪，我劝你赶紧投案自首吧。”
“你有什么证据，能证明以上的事情是我做的？”
“你现在是这家公司的董事长，这还不能证明吗？”
“这是商业行为，我收购了这家公司，是你情我愿的事，但是我并没有杀害超香宫次郎。”
“你跟我说这些没有用，整个帝京的高层都认为这件事是你干的，你跑不了的。”
“整个帝京的高层有什么用，警视厅还不是你说了算。”
“我也认为这些案子都是你干的，”
“那你来抓我呀！”叶开挑衅地看着木谷梨乃。
木谷梨乃装模作样地把手按在手铐上。

叶开突然出手，把木谷梨乃抱起来摁在桌子上。
“你不能这样，我是警察，你这样做是袭警，罪上加罪！”
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: The Rebellion in the Countryside Volume 1: Default Chapter 570 Rino Kitani investigates the case (..la) Two days later, Prince Chaoxiang Palace suddenly died suddenly. Due to his special status, it attracted great attention from the Japanese government and the public.
Many people thought that the death of Prince Chaoka Palace was very strange. In addition, his two sons, Chaoka Palace Taro and Chaoka Palace Jiro, both mysteriously disappeared. Some people suggested that the Teijing Metropolitan Police Department intervene in the investigation.
All the qualified police officers in the Teikyo Metropolitan Police Department were killed. Rino Kidani became the most senior police officer and naturally became the director.
Rino Kidani came to the Prince's Mansion and took a closer look. There were no wounds on Prince Chaokagiya's body, and there were no signs of poisoning.
Forensic medicine determined that the death was sudden cardiac death. Since the onset occurred at night, there was no time for rescue.
Rino Kidani came to the Teikyo Electric Power Group and keenly discovered that not only Chaoka Miyataro was missing, but all the male employees of the entire group were missing, and female employees over forty years old were also missing.
There are only a few young and beautiful female employees working in the entire headquarters, who look very eye-catching.
Rino Kidani came to Teikyo Petrochemical Group again and found that the situation here was similar to that of Teikyo Electric Power Group, with some young and beautiful female employees working in the office.
She knew it well and knew that it must be Ye Kai who did it.
She called Ye Kai and said affectionately, "Husband, where are you?"
Ye Kai has already guessed why Rino Kitani is looking for him. It must be the case of Prince Asaka Palace.
"Honey, why did you remember to call me today?"
"We haven't seen each other for a long time. I miss you very much."
"Do you really miss me? Why haven't you called me since I haven't seen you for so many days?"
"As a director, you have a busy schedule."
"Are you busy at work or do you have a new love?"
"It's really busy. The entire Metropolitan Police Department is full of new people. I'm exhausted."
"Do you really miss me?"
"Really, I'm almost exhausted from thinking about it."
"Why doesn't it work?"
Kitani Rino said coquettishly, "I hate it, it's not like you don't know. Tell me quickly, where are you?"
"I'm in the Electric Power Group."
"Which power group?"
"Who else is it? It's Dijing Electric Power Group."
"Ah, what a coincidence. Which office are you in?"
"I'm in the chairman's office."
Before she finished speaking, Rino Kidani had already pushed open the door of the chairman's office and came in.
She closed the door, came to sit in front of Ye Kai, and said seriously, "Mr. Ye, you are in trouble."
"What's my trouble?"
"Don't you know what you did?"
"What did I do?"
"You killed Prince Chaokagiya, as well as his sons Chaokagiya Taro and Chaokamiyajiro. You merged their companies and killed the male employees, leaving only the young and beautiful female employees. You committed a serious crime. I advise you to surrender as soon as possible."
"What evidence do you have to prove that I did the above things?"
"You are now the chairman of this company. Doesn't this prove it?"
"This is a business behavior. I acquired this company as a matter of mutual consent, but I did not kill Chaoka Miyajiro."
"It's useless for you to tell me this. The entire Imperial Capital's senior management believes that you did this, and you can't run away."
"What's the use of the entire Imperial Capital's senior management? It's not you who has the final say in the Metropolitan Police Department."
"I also think these cases were all your fault,"
"Then come and catch me!" Ye Kai looked at Kugu Rino provocatively.
Rino Kidani pretended to put her hands on the handcuffs.
Ye Kai suddenly took action, picked up Rino Kiya and pressed her down on the table.
"You can't do this. I'm a police officer. If you do this, you're assaulting the police. It's an added crime!"
